notes.title: Patch Notes – Alpha Version 34
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Notes – Alpha Version 34[/h1][p]A new update is live! This patch brings several quality-of-life improvements, new content, and gameplay tweaks. Here's everything that's changed:[/p][h2]New Features[/h2][p][b]Victory Screen Overhaul[/b]
We've added a detailed victory screen that displays stats from your completed runs.
You can now view your past victories under [b]"Stats"[/b] on the main page (button only appears if you've won at least once).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/64d1d5379735a0e49cb531163b928dda78e7035e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Map Access During Beach Trading[/b]
You can now open the map while trading on the beach, making it easier to plan your route.[/p][h2]New Content[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p][b]New Bag[/b]: Ripped Bag[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/c8127fc72a82e51a0df6789e17909215fc8c91a6.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]New Stone[/b]: Hematoid Quartz [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/37ec6321e9c6de2d85fa9e2ec863c5ced50f7d78.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h2]Balance Changes[/h2][p][b]Epic Frequency Modifiers[/b]
Epic modifiers are now more generous, giving you better chances to build powerful combinations.[/p][h3]Shop Improvements[/h3][p][b]Stone Rarity Indicators[/b]
Epic and rare stones now have a star behind them in shops, making them easier to spot.[/p][h3]Gameplay Updates[/h3][p][b]Path of Initiation – Final Match Rework[/b]
The last match has been changed to something (hopefully) more fun than Cloudsurfer. Let us know what you think![/p][p][b]Magnetite Rework[/b]
Magnetite now gains 1 Glimmer every time [i]any[/i] stone moves. This opens up new strategic possibilities.[/p][h1]
UI & Terminology[/h1][list][*][p]Buttons have received a visual refresh for a cleaner look.[/p][/*][*][p]We've updated terminology: "tile" is now used instead of "space" for consistency.
[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We´re also looking for some more testers, tell your friends!


Happy midsummer from the Pointless Games team.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr]

notes.title: A Whole Bag of Things Update
notes.notes:
Dropping in early with a lot of new content for this week's update!

[h2]Bags[/h2]
Three new bags have been added:
[list]
[*] Bag of Bags - Beach traders always offer at least 1 bag.
[*] Bag of Savings - Energy and removals are saved between turns.
[*] Amber Bag - All your stones keeps all buffs and debuffs when removed and after match.
[/list]

[h2]Enemy & Rivals[/h2]
New enemy called Gloop has been added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/fb38635f5894a8e3fb4a3d437b8aefbe7f2911b3.png[/img]

A new rival called The Lurker has been added.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/7ac7c57bed0b0892c8d2390280949202fb980cb8.png[/img]

Archaeologist and The Hag have received proper assets:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/7c88b367e164a33b6c1f6d688215ca482876a155.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/b909fd644acec572ad75343a5d9baa26dfd14166.png[/img]

[h2]Balance changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Made Kyanite 4 coins cheaper
[*] Lapiz Lazuli costs 1 to activate instead of 2.
[*] Made Malachite better: gains +4 power (instead of +3) if it has at least 5 power.
[/list]

notes.title: The Rival Update
notes.notes:
[h1]New Features[/h1]
Late drop with new enemy, new rival and a new path, so let's get cracking!

[h2]New Path - Path of Hardship[/h2]
There is now a new path called Path of Hardship. This path will be automatically unlocked if you have completed Path of Determination.

Note that this path is much harder than the previous paths.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/1d0d6863fe7dc266217401d7b5ff6e6d02b2307d.png[/img]

[h2]Rivals[/h2]
RIvals is a final, more difficult, enemy that shows up at the end of a path. Currently there is one Rival, called "The Hag" and shows up at the end of [b]Path of Determination[/b] and [b]Path of Hardship[/b]. It is a first iteration and character assets are still placeholder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/b978cd714019575be1cbaa7aa96c6f29faae9d98.png[/img]

[h2]New Enemy - The Archaeologist[/h2]
There is a now a first iteration of a new enemy called The Archaeologist. This enemy only shows up in [b]Path of Hardship[/b]. It is a first iteration and character assets are still placeholder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/818436f1671e618504568241619c66b33d7d5479.png[/img]

notes.title: The Face Update
notes.notes:
[h1]New Features[/h1]
Faces added! No more losing coins on draw or insta-lose on defeat! You have 3 faces. If you manage to get the enemy prestige down to 0 you gain some coin. If your prestige reaches 0 you lose (one) face! When the last face is lost the run is over - ultimate shame.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/22a454a76fb315f864e727a52023444a33f0fe99.png[/img]

[h1]UI and Smaller changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Coin effect on end of match.
[*] Win summary now includes gold and stones gained during the match
[*] Preview now includes image of stones and not just arrows 
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes and improvements[/h1]
This update impacted 20 000 lines of code which makes it hard to summarise the improvements. While most of these improvements will help future development here are some of the more notable changes for this update:
[list]
[*] You can now queue multiple actions, making the game smoother.
[*] Flint no longer crashes the game when having more than 9 smudge. 
[*] Enemy brains are now more streamlined and improved.
[*] All stones have been removed and re-implemented using new data-driven system.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/f391b2846d865c0a7c0a629f315a4c4313e16a9b.png[/img]

notes.title: The Sound Update
notes.notes:
The silence has been going on for long enough and it’s time for the first update with sounds that will let you really immerse yourself as you throw your combos on the beach!

This is the first update of two, targeting music and some sound effects. In this update we have:
[list]
[*] Background beach sounds and music
[*] Sound effect for drawing stones
[*] Sound effect for placing stone
[*] Sound effect for moving stone
[*] Settings to turn music and sound effects off and on
[/list]

Have a fun and relaxing run!

notes.title: Surprise Update
notes.notes:
Happy New Year and we are back with the first update of the year! 
[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
During the break we’ve been able to take some time to play and in the process done a lot of rebalancing and tweaks. The highlights:
[list]
[*] Rebalanced coin rewards after matches. Coin reward is now around the value of 1 stone at the start of the run and around the value of 2 stones towards the end.
[*] Starter stones are no longer offered by the traders
[*] Gemologist has been slightly nerfed
[*] Rebalanced Soapstone and tibetan quartz
[/list]
[h2]New Stones[/h2]
[h3]Cinnabar[/h3]
[b]Rarity:[/b] Common
[b]Base Power:[/b] 0
[b]Abilities:[/b]
[list]
[*] On activate: Apply 1 bleed to each adjacent neighbour. Gain shine equal to the total bleed on neighbours. Activation cost is 1
[*] On remove: Apply 1 bleed to each adjacent neighbour.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/96ed042948c08ed5baf2791aa9c368a52ffa7435.png[/img]

[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/edbe90c293a98bb688147c93a748108c5898b4ec.png[/img]

Has +3 power for each static charge on stone
[b]Rarity:[/b] Common
[b]Base Power:[/b] 0

[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/e35f8c501b85e4dc76ebcea10563eb33e34e797d.png[/img]
[h3]Heliotrope[/h3]
[b]Rarity:[/b] Common
[b]Base Power:[/b] 3
[b]Abilities:[/b]
[list]
[*] On preparation: Apply 1 bleed to each adjacent neighbour
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/723e1273f97e018600b0564cba767702bc3b6bde.png[/img]
[h3]Ruby[/h3]
[b]Rarity:[/b] Common
[b]Base Power:[/b] 0
[b]Abilities:[/b]
[list]
[*] On activate: Gain 36 power. Activation cost is 6
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/bfcfa2a751e9d6facbead42ffbc846963fbcb4ae.png[/img]
[h2]Other Changes[/h2]

notes.title: Community Bag Update
notes.notes:
We asked for bag ideas and wow, the community delivered! There were so many great suggestions from the community that we decided to add not only one bag, but three. Enjoy trying out these amazing new bags in the latest update!

[h3]Thief’s Bag [/h3]
[b]Pitched by:[/b] panda4994
When you win a match, steal 2 random stones from your opponent's bag.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/22116c653f5e8cfec491bf5e0bec22598e5ff93e.png[/img]

[h3]Bag of Overpowered Removal[/h3]
[b]Pitched by:[/b] esillen
Your stones can be removed the same turn they are placed. Start each match with 1 removal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/d1884998c4f53f51af0e28d7681cc838ef2ed7da.png[/img]

[h3]Party Bag[/h3]
[b]Pitched by:[/b] Daniel Schaublin
If your bag contains at least 3 [Mineral]s, draw 1 extra stone each turn."
If your bag contains at least 3 [Gem]s, all your stones have +1 extra base power.
If your bag contains at least 3 [Crystal]s, gain 2 extra removal each turn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/62bf5889b30523c958748f94d458fce613d00137.png[/img]

notes.title: Kicking off Update Announcements
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It's been 10 weeks since we put up the first closed alpha of Stones of Power on Steam and every single week we've been pushing new updates with features and changes. It’s been really cool to see you all trying it out and we now want to make sure we are communicating the changes regularly. Moving forward you will find the Patch Notes for each update in the News feed here 🙂

We're going to use this News post to summarise all the changes that have happened since August
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/d410e2b7171ce2981138de183da60c01060fd725.png[/img]

[h1]Where we started[/h1]
To kick us off lets have a look at where we started:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/bfa7a040d9c74b8b2854c3c21354c8e73ae8c81a.png[/img]
* Silently screams at the amount of text in the tooltip *
First alpha had:
[list]
[*] 1 Placeholder Enemy (Rocky) that went up to 100 prestige
[*] 20 stones
[*] Super annoying tooltips with a lot of text
[/list]
[h1]Where we are at[/h1]
Since August we have added a whole bunch of things!

[h2]New enemies[/h2]
[h3]The Abyssal[/h3]
The Abyssal works a lot with board manipulation and is also being used as our current final boss placeholder The Abyssal OP AF with 300 prestige.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/7adbb8acdcc574d180312e77d3f2e8292c5a2652.png[/img]

Side note - Did you know you can get to more than 900 damage in a single turn? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/737ca314ac60c12133ef8553745b2cdf956d193d.png[/img]

[h3]The Gemologist[/h3]
The Gemologist focuses on stone types and board control. We are considering changing their name to highlight their more feline features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/d67116fe2b536c717379d3759cf5bb38f7e971b6.png[/img]

[h3]Drifter and Cloudsurfer[/h3]
Both the Cloudsurfer and Drifter are enemies that are about exploring early game combos. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/5f5553ae9dd78e490c84e010a9de51c1d4b07acf.png[/img]

Here you can also see the reference image we used when creating the art
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/2c3f53d335bfa45a450834e8c242f48a365a716b.png[/img]

[h2]New stones[/h2]
We have added 12 new stones. We're taking it slow now in the beginning as we're focus on nailing the core game mechanics before we add too much content

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/3e9bd3d9f693973e32dda49a44bebcefc01ee1eb.png[/img]

[h2]Bags[/h2]
Bags are a recent addition which impact your whole stone collection throughout the run. There are 12 different ones to choose from right now
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/59af7fdede8b397d2cc544f971228bf6b7d43bdc.png[/img]

[h2]UI and Visuals[/h2]
We have also added a bunch of visual changes and UI improvements such as preview stone effects, journey progression and nicer backgrounds
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/d00a1fdf5dc4a05f8f748ad46876269cf3bc006d.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/3ca586583addc1a5f2b7111c63c383e5be4a5b2b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224931/8c72f2790be7db053d78ee03d5d1c653b7ae42ab.png[/img]


We're now going to prepare a small update that we hope to ship later today - see ya'll later!
